# Parag Jain

> AI Solutions Architect and GenAI consultant with 24+ years of enterprise consulting experience. Available for full-time, contract, and advisory engagements in Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic RAG, and Cloud Architecture.

Parag Jain is a Lead Architect and GenAI Account Partner at IBM Consulting. He designs and delivers enterprise GenAI productivity assets — LLM-based enterprise assistants, agentic AI frameworks, and scalable data platforms across Banking, Healthcare, Automotive, and Logistics.
